name: Tomás A. Chang Pico
title: Organisational Growth, Grants & Governance Advisor
bio: Tomás advises civil society organisations on complex governance challenges and on navigating funding uncertainty. With 15 years of experience across Latin America, South East Asia, Africa and Europe, he brings hands-on expertise in NGO due diligence, organisational capacity development and grant management. He also has ample NGO board experience. He works in Spanish, English, and Dutch.
